scope: all Infinite Domain deep-sea structures and geological features
required_sequence: declare asset_class, depth band, biome scope, and (for structures) build style, burial state, access connector
build and preserve an intact clean master for every structure
derive damage variants using the controlled damage vocabulary, spatially coherent to one legible cause
derive occupation variants using the controlled occupation vocabulary

for a damage variant whose cause is a discrete physical event, derive the event first and author the geometry from it: docs/deepsea-akula-impact-simulation.json is the reference, and validate_deep_sea_structures.py checks the authored attitude against the model rather than trusting that the two still agree
validate metadata, source-NBT dimensions, and per-compartment atmosphere fill
render isometric and floor-slice evidence for every derivative
register worldgen placement behind the quarantine biome tag and log it in docs/biome-gating-audit/ocean-structure-sets.csv
walk the structure in the QA world and test the access connector against installed submersibles
admit to production world generation only after explicit human approval
